summary: The Speechmatics Startup Program gives early-stage, voice-first startups up to $50,000 in usage credits spendable across batch and real-time speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and on-prem deployments, plus monthly office hours with engineers, priority developer support, early feature access, and co-marketing. Eligibility: raised less than $10M total, functional MVP in production or committed launch within 1-2 months, not on a paid enterprise plan, active dev team, defined ASR use case. Cohorts are capped at ~20 startups; a 30-minute call precedes the decision.
claim_steps: Apply via the Startup Program form at https://www.speechmatics.com/startup-program (rolling review, response within a few days).
Join a 30-minute call with the Speechmatics team about your use case and mission.
On approval, credits activate immediately; spend them on batch, real-time, TTS, or on-prem.

social_proof.title: Speechmatics Startup Program: Unlock $50K Credits
social_proof.text: Get up to $50k in Speechmatics usage credits. Spend it across our real-time and batch speech-to-text APIs. Raised less than $10 million total. We cap at 20 startups per cohort.
